verdict.rationale: gstack shows some automation behavior—terminal-driven checks that react to new output instead of polling (docs-33), an auto-review pipeline that runs sequentially with auto-decisions (docs-5), and a request router that dispatches to the right skill (docs-18)—but there's no evidence of a general-purpose rule/trigger system where an AI-native user defines custom conditions and actions on arbitrary events. missing for 10: user-definable rule/trigger syntax, list of supported event types, examples of custom conditional automations beyond the built-in skill pipelines.
